Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the source of energy in the human body. It claimed that "heat energy is converted into mechanical motion," which contradicts the fundamental principle of thermodynamics and biology. In the human body, chemical energy (stored in ATP and food molecules) is converted into kinetic energy (motion) and thermal energy (heat). Heat is a byproduct of inefficiency, not the primary fuel source that drives motion. By selecting option C ("Heat changes to motion..."), the agent confused the byproduct of metabolism with the input energy source, leading to a scientifically invalid conclusion.
